artificial_masking.json.meaning: artificially hidden values on conditional fully in-stock days; organic missing demand remains unidentified

grid_bound.derivation: For identical per-item caps and capacity, round continuous q down to grid. Feasibility preserved; loss increases by at most shortage_weight * step per item. Bound concerns declared scenario objective, not realized retailer outcomes.

weekly_summary.json.fixed_fit: No refits per origin; observed prior-day lags updated. One-day-ahead forecast, not fixed-origin seven-day prediction.
weekly_summary.json.window_definition: 2025-05-01 anchored consecutive non-overlapping 7-day blocks; partial final block reported separately
